method.normalization: Absolute branch targets and adrp/add page-offset pairs are normalized for exact comparison; all immediates are additionally masked for shape comparison.
method.matching: Aggregate hashes are multiset-matched. Named functions are compared only when the same symbol is at the exact function start in both images.
method.function_start_count_correction: The earlier 1,361/1,382 count was an undercount. ipsw macho info -f and an independent LC_FUNCTION_STARTS decode both give 20,873/20,897; see EVD-0023 and EVD-0027.

triage_candidates.selection_basis: Kernel attack-surface name heuristic: IPC, VM, process, filesystem, networking, and exception paths. This is not a CVE map or proof that a change is security-relevant.

limitations: Function starts are taken from ipsw and may include labels that are not semantic function boundaries; instruction-count changes are not proof of a semantic change.
Address normalization cannot distinguish a real immediate change from a layout-dependent address materialization in every case.
Named comparison covers only functions that symbolicator named at the exact start address; 52 old-only and 51 new-only names remain unmatched.
The image is stripped; no source-level semantics, call-graph equivalence, or CVE attribution is established.
No device was connected; runtime behavior and exploitability were not measured.
